facts.meaning: Local committed log prefix endpoint; leader advancement through maybeCommit uses the current voter quorum index only when that entry has the current term. Other establishment paths include follower replication and snapshot restoration and are not fully mapped yet.
facts.validity_context: Committed history persists across authority changes; this is not application completion or a guarantee of local physical durability at the instant of field update.
facts.durability: HardState/entries persistence is performed by caller; precise restart reconstruction remains open.
facts.recovery: Storage and snapshot reconstruction paths require further reading.
unknowns: Snapshot and initialization producers remain unmapped

surfaces.reason: Automatic exit proposal may be rejected during transfer; comment relies on next applied entry/advance. Trace transfer abort and continuation ownership before deriving a progress requirement.
Commit advancement here broadcasts but does not invoke pending-read release. Establish reachable pending requests and contract before testing.

formation.explanation: Leader assigns term/index, replicates entries, consumes persistence-qualified acknowledgments into Match, and commits a current-term quorum index. Followers match predecessor, repair uncommitted suffix, and learn commit; Ready hands committed entries to application.

context.explanation: Pre-vote can precede real term increment; log freshness and voting restrictions qualify grants, current voter aggregation determines election. Higher terms normally force follower, with lease/pre-vote exceptions. Reset discards volatile support and active read tracking; committed log is retained.

connection.explanation: Support is interpreted under applied voter configuration and current leader term. New leader resets remote progress and appends an empty current-term entry before old history can advance through a new current-term commitment. Membership application can reinterpret existing support and directly advance commit. Persistence completion is a separate boundary from protocol receipt.
